name: skraft-brownfield
description: skraft brownfield — characterize a legacy codebase into a PRD, lock its current behaviour under characterization tests, then refactor it safely with the Mikado Method or a Strangler Fig.

interface.shortDescription: Characterize a legacy codebase, lock its behaviour, refactor it safely.
interface.longDescription: skraft-brownfield takes an undocumented codebase from reverse-engineering to safe change. The analyst turns the code into confidence-scored characterization artefacts and a PRD; the harness builder discovers or reconstructs the API contract and writes characterization tests that pin current behaviour, bugs included; the refactorer then drives a Mikado graph or a Strangler Fig slice plan one leaf or slice at a time, each in a fresh worker, keeping the safety net green at every commit. It installs next to the skraft plugin and reuses its contract-testing and mocking skills by name.
defaultPrompt: Characterize this codebase and draft a PRD from it.
Build a safety net for this service before I refactor it.
Refactor this module safely with the Mikado Method.
